text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I was really curious about this 
limited-time menu item, the 'Seize #1! 
Super Dreadnought Stamina Bowl'..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because it says "Number 1", doesn't it!? 
There's no way I could just pass that up!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“Still... this looks like a huge portion. 
I have a race coming up, so this might be 
bad...”

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Missing out on "Number 1"... that 
just wouldn't be me...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aaagh, what am I supposed to do now!
choice_data_list:
I have to endure it for now, to take first 
place in the race!
Eat your fill and seize 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"R-Right! The 'number one' I should be 
aiming for is in races!"
choice_data_list: If we win, let's eat up to celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, well said! When that time comes, 
I'll be the very first to eat it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"R-Right! If I eat and exercise, I can 
easily burn this off! And once I win, it 
won't be an issue at all!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, let's go take 
that "Number 1" spot!
